entities.name: Query MurE ligase
observations: 501-aa soluble enzyme sequence with Pfam Mur_ligase (PF01225), Mur_ligase_M (PF08245), and Mur_ligase_C (PF02875) domains.
Closest reviewed homolog A1WC11 shows 60.7% identity over 98.6% query coverage and is annotated as UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate—2,6-diaminopimelate ligase.
Sequence-based assignment is moderate homology support; exact organism-specific substrate preference is inferred rather than experimentally demonstrated for this query.

entities.name: MurE DAP ligase reaction
observations: The reaction is EC 6.3.2.13 and is mapped to Rhea RHEA:23676.
Mg2+ is a cofactor for the ATP-dependent ligase reaction.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: MurE activity occurs in bacterial cell-wall peptidoglycan biosynthesis, producing the UDP-MurNAc-tripeptide precursor.
The enzyme is expected to be cytoplasmic based on reviewed homolog annotations.
